versions.changelog:
- Initial release of guaikei-xiaohongshu-multi-data-tool.
- Enables structured data extraction from Xiaohongshu: keyword search, note details, comment analysis, and creator posts, up to 10,000 entries per request.
- Four main command-line scripts for different data acquisition needs; outputs unified JSON for easy downstream analysis.
- Requires GUAIKEI_API_TOKEN environment variable; all functionality operates on public Xiaohongshu data only.
- Designed for research, content analysis, competitor tracking, and internal reporting—not for posting or interacting on Xiaohongshu.
